properties.name: BLR9
properties.site-address: Oakley Mills, Oakley's Road, Long Eaton, Derbyshire, NG10 1FQ
properties.notes: This site has no residential planning applications submitted. The site is able to support 50 dwellings (a mixture of different house types is possible on this site depending on density and dwelling type chosen). In regards to hazardous substances, the site is a former textiles mill (known as Oakley's Mill and Acton Mill). Additionally, part of the site former part of a castings foundry. Ground contamination of the site is likely due to historic use. Likely contaminants are those outlined in the 'Textiles Works and Dye Works' Department of Environment Industry Profile, produced by CL:AIRE. The site is SHLAA 115 2019 site and is accepted to deliver homes within the next 5 years. This site is in the SHLAA2019 Ref 115.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
